tei:div.tei:p: "$ (525)༄༅// bstan srung gtso mo dud pa'i sol ba ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so/// /

(526)༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ yum gyur rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// ma mo gtso mo'i tshul bzung nas// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bstan pa skyong*// de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ dpal ldan dud sol mar grags pa 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya'o// de la stegs bu gru bzhi la 'brub khung gru gsum/ de'i dbus kyi thod pa'i zlum skor nang zur gsum du rdo rje phyed pa gsum gyis mtshan pa/ dbus su nas nag gi tshom bu bkod/ mdun du mañjil/ ra nag dang bya nag gi sha gtso bor gyur pa'i sha khrag sna tshogs pas sbags pa'i gtor ma che ba zhig bsham/ mchod pa sna tshogs pas mtha' bskor/ bdag bskyed brgyud pa 'di nyid dang mtshungs pa'i dges rdor mā yā gdan bzhi la sogs pa'am/ khro bo gang yang rung ba'i mngon rtogs sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa byin gyis brlab/ mdun du skad cig gis lha mo dud sol ma bzhugs pa'i snying gar/ oṃ dkar po la gnas pa'i ra yig dmar po/ ra las me 'od 'phro ba/ sku lus skad cig gis bsregs/ oṃ de'i steng du paṃ yongs su gyur paṃ las bum pa dkar po bdud rtsis gang ba/ de las bdud rtsi lud de/ oṃ bkrus pas 'od zer dkar po rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ oṃ aṃ ma hā kā li/ de wī ka ra li/ (527)bi krān+ta tsaṇ+ḍa ru pi ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nyid skad cig gis dpal ldan lha mo'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog nag mo/ keng rus ltar skem pa'i lus can/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis pa g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na bhañja dmar chen gyis bskyil ba/ g.yon gyi dang po na shak+ti// gnyis pa na tri shū la dar dpyangs can 'dzin pa/ mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ral pa dmar ser gyen brdzes lan bu g.yon du 'khyil ba/ sbrul dang thod phreng gis brgyan pa/ snyan g.yas na dril bu'i mgul rgyan gyi sbrul dang*/

g.yon na seng ges brgyan pa/ me tog dang dar nag gi cod pan can/ lha ma yin gyi mgo bos do shal byas pa/ glang po che'i ko bas g.yogs shing*/ ba glang gi pags pas re lde ser po'i sham bu can gyis smad dkris pa la/ klu'i rgyal po gshibs pas ske rag byas pa/ lcags sgrog gis brgyan pa'i zhabs gnyis bong bu gwa ba'i steng na btsan bskyil gyis bzhugs pa/ dur khrod (528)kyi dbus na sgra drag po sgrog cing*/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sdes bskor ba/ de'i thugs kar thugs kyi ye shes mar me ltar 'bar ba sgo nga'i dbyibs can sor bzhi ba/ de'i dbus su hūm̐/ mtha' skor du oṃ hūm̐ shrī ye/ de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūm̐ bh+yo/ zhes pas bskor bar gyur/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ gcig chad de bha gar thim/ badz+ra lā s+ya rā ga yā mi/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i lha mo dpal nag mo 'bum sde dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza/ zhes spyan drangs/ /oṃ shrī ye de wi kā li kā li ma hā ka li hūm̐ bh+yo/ dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ zhes pas gnyis su med pa thim/ 'khor nag mo 'bum sde thams cad kyang gcer bu ral pa can g.yas mi snying dang*/ g.yon bhan+dha skra can thogs pa'o// thams cad kyi thugs kar yang bh+yo yig gis mtshan pa/ dud pa'i sol ba ma khyod kyi sku myur du ston cig /sku ma ston na yang yid la gang 'dod pa de 'grub par gyis shig /nang mchod gtor la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ ha na ha na badz+ra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma naṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dam la bzhag /oṃ hūm̐ shri ye sogs snying po'i mthar/ badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe/

gan+dhe/ nai wi t+ya/ ā lo ka ེ zhes sbyar/ gtor ma'i nang du ha ser po hoḥdakar po hrīḥsngon po de rnams kyi 'od kyis kha dog dri ro ngan pa bcom ste/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ha hoḥhrīḥswā hā/ lan gsum brjod/ oṃ hūm̐ sogs kyi/ mthar/ oṃ ma hā maṃ sa khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi i daṃ ba liṃ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa pā ya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan bdun gyis phul bas 'khor dang bcas pas gsol bar bsam/ bar 'dir bstod pa til mar ma dang*/ gzhan yang bstod pa'i bye brag ci shes kyis bstod pa yin la/ bsdu na/ dpal ldan lha mo mi pham (529)srid gsum bdag /rang don sgrub phyir rnam thar la gzhol yang*// snying rje'i dbang gis rjes la thob pa yi// shes rab sna tshogs dag gis 'gro don mdzad// lho phyogs gshin rje'i pho brang rtag tu gnas/ khams gsum skad cig tsam gyis skor bar byed// gzhan la dbang bskur 'dod khams ya mthar phyin// dbang phyug chen po'i sku la dgyes 'khril ma// lha dbang brgya byin lha min dbang po dang*// tshangs pa'i rgyal po sa 'og dbang po dang*// rgyal chen bzhi la sogs pas phyag byas ma// bdud dang gshin rje'i rgyal po 'dar zhing 'dud// mtshan mo nag mo shin tu gtum pa'i gzugs// ma mo srin mo'i tshogs rnams 'dar zhing dngangs// phyogs bcu'i dug bsdus nyi ma tshims par mdzad// nad rnams slong byed nad bdag dam la 'du// bdud rtsi'i bcud bsdus zla bar tshim mdzad ma// nad yams gcod mdzad sman mo dam la 'du// gang zhig khyod la dad na ma bas byams// lha mo khyod la bdag gis rtag tu bstod/ rak+ta dang chang gtor ma la gtor zhing*/ oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha/ ba to si/ kā ma la rak+ṣa si hūm̐ bh+yo/ dgra bgegs mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ sngags de nyid dam/ oṃ hūm̐ shri sogs gang 'grub bzla/ mche ba'i phyag rgya kha'i grur bcas la/

oṃ bh+yoḥbarta li brta li tshe/ kha phrus btab la/ hūm̐/ dur khrod bdag mo dngos grub zhal// gtum mo gtsigs byed yi dwags kha// dam tshig srung ma grag dga' mo// ki li'i sgra sgrog sbyor zin ma// dur khrod ro yi tshal dbus su// tshogs dang pho nyar bcas pa ru// gtsigs byed lha mo dud sol ma// gsol zhig bzhes shig dam tshig lha// gnas su gnas par mdzad du gsol// bdag gi sems la ci 'dod pa// de ni khyod kyis grub par gyis// bdag gi las ni ci byed kyang*// de la kun gyi grogs gyis shig /gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ (530)phreṃ phruṃ phreṃ phroṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod la se gol gdab/ phrin las bcol 'dod don gsal btab gang 'os bya/ de ltar bgyi'o// zhes zhal gyis bzhes par bsam/ gtor ma gtsang sar btang*/ dge ba bsngo/ 'di'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod na/ maṇ+ḍal gru gsum gyi steng du/ rten gtor bcas la/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed gong du bshad pa ltar byas la/ gtor 'bul phrin bcol yan chad grub pa dang*/ slob ma la khrus chab btang*/ me tog bkye bsdu dang sems bskyed gsal btab la/ de'ang dpal ldan lha mo dud pa'i sol ba ma 'di nyid don dam par rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum rnam thar gsum ldan shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma zhes bya ba nyid/ rnam bcas lha mo'i rnam par bzhengs pa na bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo dang*/ rdo rje bdag med ma zhes bya ba sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs du mas bsnyad par gyur pa ste/ ji skad du/ dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /rang don bsgrub phyir rnam thar la gzhol yang*// snying rje'i dbang gis rjes la thob pa yis// shes rab sna tshogs dag gis 'gro don mdzad/ ces gsungs pa bzhin// bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje bdag med ma nyid// ma mo'i tshogs kyi dbang phyug tu bzhengs te/

de yang 'jigs byed he ru ka legs ldan nag po chen po rnams dang dgyes bder spyod pa'i rang snang shes rab kyi yum la'ang*/ ngo bo gcig la ldog chas bya ba'am/ dbyings yum/ sbyor yum/ sgrol yum zhes 'ga' zhig tu dbye bar mdzad pa'i dbyings yum e ka dza ḍi ste sngags bdag ral gcig ma dang*/ sbyor yum tsaṇ+ḍe shwa ri/ sgrol yum dud sol ma zhes grags mod// nges don dbyings su dbye ba med kyang*/ rnam 'gyur gyi dbang du byas pa de'i phyir dpal ldan lha mo 'di nyid rgyal ba'i spyan sngar thugs bskyed cing*/ bstan srung gtso mor dbang bskur ba dang*/ gzhan tu rgya mtsho'i lha mo dbyangs can ma'i ngo bo yin pas de dag gi tshul rgyud du gsal zhing*/ mdor na (531)dpal ldan ye shes lha mo 'di nyid rgya bod kyi mkhas grub thams cad kyi srung ma'i gtso bor mdzad/ khyad par rje nā ro ta pa'i bka' srung gi gtso mor bsnyen cing*/ des rje mar la lo tsā ba la/ dud sol lha mo rgyud srung mchog /bu tsha bo yang tsha'i don du ni// lo tsā ba yis spyan drangs la// dus gsum ba liṃ ma chags gyis// mchog thun dngos grub gdon mi za// chu bo gaṅgā phan chad du// de snga med pa'i chos skyong yin// dka' bar ma dgongs nyams su longs/ zhes gsungs bzhin gnang*/ mar pa lo tsā bas rngog ston la bstan srung brgya dang rtsa brgyad kyi snying po yin ces gnang bas mar rngog rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i srung ma'i gtso mor bstan pa yin no// 'di la rjes gnang gi bka' srol 'dra min 'ga' zhig mchis pa las skabs 'dir rngog blo gros dpal bzang nas rje grol mchog zhabs la brgyud pa'i lugs ltar gyi rjes su gnang ba bsgrub par bgyi ba la sogs kyi mtshams sbyar nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du bzhug /thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dpal ldan mgon po brtse ba can// ye shes lha mo 'khor bcas kyi// rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/

zhes lan gsum/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs lan gsum/ de nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi rten gtor skad cig gis dpal ldan lha mo'i skur gyur pa ni/ sogs nas/ zhes pas bskor bar gsal thob// mdun bskyed dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer spyan drangs te bstims pas/ sdig sgrib sbyangs/ yang lha mo'i sku dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te khyed rang (532)rnams la sib sib thim par sgoms shig /rol mo'i sgra bya'o/ spos bdug /snying po'i mthar/ ā be sha ya/ ā be sha ya/ ra ra/ ra ra/ tsā la ya/ tsā la ya/ hūm̐ a ha dzhaiṃḥ zhes lan brgya rtsa brgyad brjod/ de nas khyed rang rnams skad cig gis lha mo dud sol mar gyur pa'i snying gar/ sogs nas/ sha za 'bum sdes bskor ba'i sku gyur par sgoms shig /dpral bar dri bzang gi thig le byas la/ snying po'i mthar/ oṃ kā ya badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūm̐/ sku'i byin rlabs brtan par byas par mos shig /des dpal lha mo'i sku'i rjes gnang thob pa yin no// de nas slob dpon la mos gus byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed dpal lha mo'i thugs kar phog /de'i thugs kar thugs kyi ye shes mar me ltar 'bar ba'i sgo nga'i dbyibs can sor bzhi pa'i dbus su gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa 'phros te zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar 'od kyi gong bu'i dbus su gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar 'khod par mos la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ snying po lan gsum/ dang pos byin gyis brlab/ gnyis pas dbyer med du 'dres/ gsum pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin tu 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

lha mo bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /ces lan gsum/ de ltar phul ba'i me tog de nyid slar yang byin gyis brlabs te khyed rang gi spyi bor phul ba'i mos pa mdzod cig /slob dpon gyi me tog gtor zhing*/ lha mo 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams la dpal ldan lha mo dud pa'i sol ba ma'i gsung rig sngags kyi nus pa ma lus pa thogs pa med pa 'jug par (533)gyur cig /mgrin par thig le byas la/ oṃ wā ka badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūm̐/ gsung gi byin rlabs brtan par byas par mos shig /des dpal lha mo'i gsung gi rjes gnang thob pa yin no// mdun gyi lha mo'i thugs ka nas thugs kyi ye shes phyag mtshan ral gri/ ban+da/ shak+ti/ tri shu la'i rnam pa dpag tu med pa 'phros te khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim par mos shig /rol mo'i sgra bya/ snying gar thig le byas la/ oṃ tsirta badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūm̐/ thugs kyi byin rlabs brtan par byas par mos shig /des dpal lha mo'i thugs kyi rjes gnang thob pa yin no/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i ral gri la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ka nas/ ye shes pa phyag mtshan gyi rnam par spyan drangs te bstims/ ral gri slob ma'i lag tu gtad la/ deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// gdug pa can kun tshar gcod dang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa yi// phrin las rab 'byams spyod par gyis/ oṃ badz+ra khaṅga a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ thod pa gtad la/ /gdug pa can kun tshar gcod dang*/ zhes pa'i tshab tu/ skal ldan rjes su 'dzin pa dang*/ zhes dang*/ khaṅga'i tshab tu/ badz+ra ka pā la zhes 'don pa spros/ shak+ti gtad la/ nad dang bar chad zhi ba dang*/ badz+ra shak+ti/

rtse gsum gtad la/ 'gro ba dbang du sdud pa dang*/ badz+ra tri shū la/ zhes 'don pa spo/ lte bar thig le byas la/ oṃ karma badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūm̐/ phrin las kyi byin rlabs brtan par byas par mos shig /khyed rang rnams snying gar yi dam/ de'i thugs kar bh+yo yig gi steng du hūm̐ gi mtha' skor tu/ yi dam gyi sngags kyis bskor ba sngags kyi 'od zer gyi drwa ba dam pos bh+yo yig bcings par sgoms shig /gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ni/ rten gtor thogs la/ gtor ma skad cig gis dpal ldan dud pa'i sol ba ma 'khor nag mo 'bum sde'i (534)tshogs dang bcas pa mngon gsum bzhin du gsal ba la bka' bsgos shing byin gyis brlabs pas las dang dngos grub thogs pa med par sgrub par zhal gyis bzhes par sgoms shig /dpal ye shes kyi lha mo dud pa'i sol ba ma 'khor nag mo 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ grub chen tai lo pa/ paṇa chen nā ro pa/ rje mar pa lo tsā/ rngog chos sku rdo rje nas rim par brgyud pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam tshig gi rim pa las ma 'da' bar/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ sems can gyi bde skyid spel/ bye brag tu rig pa 'dzin pa'am rdo rje'i slob ma 'di nyid/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad las srungs shig /mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sol cig /mthun rkyen thams cad sgrubs shig /spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang*/ bye brag rig pa 'dzin pa 'di nyid la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod cig /mdor na rig pa 'dzin pa 'di'i chos ldan bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsol bar mdzad du gsol/

ces brjod/ gtor ma mgor bzhag cing lag par gtad/ mthar gtor ma la nang mchod rdo rje'i rtse mos gtor la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i nas/ kra ma hūm̐/ lha mo dam la gnas par bsam/ gtor ma dang nang mchod nas cung zad gcig slob ma la sbyin la/ oṃ ro ru ro ru sogs brjod de dam tshig bsre ba'o/ deng phyin chad dpal ldan lha mo 'di nyid rtag tu bsten cing mchod gtor la brtson pa sogs skyi dang bye brag gi dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung dgos pas de ltar (535)bgyi snyam du 'di'i rjes bzlo/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs rjes spyi ltar bya/ slar yang gtor 'bul sngar ltar dang*/ dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ rten yod na rten bzhugs/ med na gshegs gsol/ bsngo smon/ bkra shis brjod pa sogs spyi ltar byas pas grub bo// ma mo kun gyi gtso gyur pa// dga' chen lhan cig skyes pa'i dngos// bstan srung brgya dang rtsa brgyad kyi// snying po yin zhes mar pas bsngags// dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// dar rgyas 'phel/ ces sgrub thabs rin 'byung las khol du phyungs te rjes gnang kha gsal bklag chog tu bkod pa'o/// /dge legs 'phel/ shubhaṃ/ (536)
